name: GreenCity Vietnam Initiative
description: An illustrative Vietnamese government-backed smart-city programme that provides municipal procurement pathways and pilot infrastructure access across Hanoi and Ho Chi Minh City. Facilitates foreign technology vendors entering Vietnamese municipal contracts.

name: CircularASEAN Hub
description: An illustrative Singapore-based circular-economy accelerator with a regional ASEAN network and grant funding for cross-border sustainability ventures. Connects hardware and IoT startups with municipal partners and impact investors across Southeast Asia.

name: EcoRoute Logistics
description: An illustrative Vietnamese startup specialising in last-mile waste logistics and collection route optimisation across Ho Chi Minh City neighbourhoods. Operates a fleet management platform integrated with local waste-hauler networks.

name: AgriLink Thailand
description: An illustrative Thai agritech startup offering IoT-based crop monitoring and precision agriculture solutions for smallholder farmers across Northern Thailand. Partners with agri-cooperatives to deploy sensor networks and data analytics platforms.

name: FinBridge Indonesia
description: An illustrative Indonesian fintech startup providing embedded micro-lending and payment solutions for SMEs in Java and Sumatra. Leverages alternative credit scoring powered by transactional data from partner ecosystems.

name: SmartPort Manila
description: An illustrative Philippine logistics consortium managing smart-port and supply-chain digitalisation projects across Manila Bay. Connects technology vendors with port operators and freight forwarders seeking operational efficiency tools.

name: GovTech Nexus Malaysia
description: An illustrative Malaysian public-private programme that co-funds and fast-tracks govtech pilots with local authorities and federal agencies. Provides regulatory sandboxes and procurement frameworks for smart-city and digital-government solutions.

name: SolarGrid Ventures
description: An illustrative Singapore-based cleantech venture studio investing in renewable energy and sustainable infrastructure startups across ASEAN. Provides seed funding, mentorship, and regional go-to-market support for climate-tech founders.

name: UrbanFlow Jakarta
description: An illustrative Indonesian smart-city startup developing real-time traffic and urban mobility analytics for Jakarta metropolitan area. Integrates city sensor feeds and satellite imagery to provide actionable congestion insights to municipal planners.

name: AquaTech Mekong
description: An illustrative Vietnamese startup deploying IoT water-quality monitoring systems along Mekong Delta waterways for aquaculture and municipal water management. Partners with provincial authorities and fish-farming cooperatives.

name: LogiChain Connect
description: An illustrative Thai logistics industry association facilitating supply-chain digitalisation and cross-border trade corridors in the Greater Mekong Sub-region. Connects technology providers with established freight and haulage operators.

name: HealthBridge Philippines
description: An illustrative Philippine healthtech startup digitising local government health records and community health worker workflows across Luzon and Visayas. Integrates with PhilHealth systems and barangay health centres.
